newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel apologises for MP's attack on U.S. envoy.
newsitem.headline: Israel apologises for MP's attack on U.S. envoy.

text.p: A right-wing Israeli lawmaker called the U.S. ambassador a "Jew boy" and a "son of a bitch" at a memorial ceremony for assassinated Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin, the Yedioth Ahronoth newspaper reported on Friday.
A U.S. embassy spokesman in Tel Aviv confirmed the report and Israel's Foreign Ministry later issued an apology.

Rehavam Zeevi, head of the ultra-nationalist Moledet party, called Ambassador Martin Indyk "yehudon" -- a Hebrew slur translated as "Jew boy" or "Yid" -- at the memorial on Thursday, the newspaper said.
Zeevi, who criticises the United States for putting pressure on Israel in talks with Arabs, used the same insult two weeks ago in parliament. He was formally rebuked.
The newspaper said Indyk, a Jew originally from Australia, told Zeevi: "The last time somebody called me a 'Jew boy' was when I was 15 and then he got a punch in the face."
Zeevi replied: "Well, try me. Let's see you. You are a Jew boy."
Indyk: "You are a disgrace to your people."
Zeevi: "You are a son of a bitch."
Yedioth said Zeevi later offered an apology which Indyk accepted.
The Foreign Ministry statement said Indyk "personifies the friendship" between Israel and the United States.
"The Foreign Ministry's director-general, Eytan Bentsur, telephoned Ambassador Indyk and expressed his regret over the offensive statements," it added.
"It is the ambassador's view that the matter is closed," U.S. spokesman Richard Scorza said.
